After the strikes, he said the Ukrainian military had been successful in intercepting cruise missiles and drones â but not ballistic missiles. articles.headline: Huge crowds fill Tehran streets for Khamenei's funeral procession
articles.summary: Many people were waving Iranian flags and red banners symbolising vengeance for the former supreme leader's war death.
articles._summary: 'The spectacle Iran wants the world to see': Lyse Doucet in Tehran Huge crowds have lined the streets of Tehran for the funeral procession of Iran's late supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, who was killed on the first day of the war with the US and Israel. Footage from Iranian state TV showed many tens of thousands of mourners gathered to watch Khamenei's flag-draped coffin being transported by a lorry along a 10km (6-mile) route that passed through the capital's landmark Enghelab Square. The procession took place after his body lay in state for two days at Tehran's Grand Mosalla mosque. Three of Khamenei's sons prayed beside his coffin there on Sunday. But Mojtaba, the son who succeeded him as supreme leader, did not make an appearance. He has not been seen in public since reporting being seriously wounded in the same Israeli air strike in Tehran on 28 February that killed his father and his wife.
articles._zh_headline: 德黑兰街道挤满了大批人群参加哈梅内伊的送葬队伍
articles._zh_summary: “伊朗希望全世界看到的奇观”：德黑兰的莱瑟·杜塞特 (Lyse Doucet) 德黑兰的街道两旁挤满了大批人群，参加伊朗已故最高领袖阿亚图拉·阿里·哈梅内伊的送葬队伍。哈梅内伊在与美国和以色列的战争的第一天被杀。伊朗国家电视台的画面显示，数以万计的哀悼者聚集在一起，观看一辆卡车沿着一条10公里（6英里）​​的路线运送哈梅内伊的灵柩，这条路线穿过首都地标性建筑恩赫拉布广场。游行活动是在他的遗体在德黑兰大莫萨拉清真寺安放两天后举行的。周日，哈梅内伊的三个儿子在他的棺材旁祈祷。但接替他成为最高领袖的儿子莫吉塔巴却没有露面。自从 2 月 28 日以色列对德黑兰的空袭导致他的父亲和妻子身亡后，他就没有在公开场合露面。

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: Inflation Turns Negative as Hormuz Reopens: Why Gold, Silver, Bitcoin May Now Rally
articles.summary: As oil slides and US jobs data cools, the Fed's rate-hike bets are unwinding, and gold, silver and Bitcoin are the early winners of the shift.
articles._summary: For most of 2026, gold, silver and Bitcoin have been a painful place to put money. The reason is not hard to find: a fast-shifting outlook for Federal Reserve policy. The year opened with hopes for rate cuts. Then the war in Iran sent energy prices surging, revived inflation, and flipped the market’s bet from lower rates to higher ones. For gold, silver and Bitcoin, assets that pay no yield and rise or fall on the path of interest rates, that shift was brutal.

articles.summary: OPEC+ members agreed to raise their collective oil‑production quotas from August even as crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz remain uncertain.
articles._summary: OPEC+ members agreed to raise their collective oil‑production quotas from August even as crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz remain uncertain. Seven nations led by Saudi Arabia and Russia will add 188,000 barrels per day to their August output target, OPEC said Sunday. Ministers from Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria and Oman approved the adjustment during virtual talks on Sunday. "The countries will continue to closely monitor and assess market conditions," OPEC said. "They reaffirmed the importance of adopting a cautious approach and retaining full flexibility to increase." The decision follows months of conflict‑driven disruption to Hormuz that pushed regional output to historic lows, forcing producers to build large inventories. The strait handles roughly a fifth of global oil flows and has remained a flashpoint between Washington and Tehran.
articles._zh_headline: 尽管霍尔木兹航运安全仍存在不确定性，OPEC+仍同意增产
articles._zh_summary: 尽管通过霍尔木兹海峡的原油运输仍存在不确定性，但 OPEC+ 成员国同意从 8 月起提高集体石油生产配额。欧佩克周日表示，以沙特阿拉伯和俄罗斯为首的七个国家将在其 8 月份产量目标的基础上增加 188,000 桶/日。沙特阿拉伯、俄罗斯、伊拉克、科威特、哈萨克斯坦、阿尔及利亚和阿曼的部长在周日的虚拟会谈中批准了这一调整。 “各国将继续密切监测和评估市场状况，”欧佩克表示。 “他们重申了采取谨慎态度并保留充分灵活性来增加的重要性。”这一决定是在霍尔木兹地区因冲突而中断数月之后做出的，该地区的产量降至历史低点，迫使生产商建立大量库存。该海峡处理着全球大约五分之一的石油流量，并且仍然是华盛顿和德黑兰之间的热点。

articles.headline: SCHD ETF Is Beating VOO and QQQ This Year Despite Limited AI Exposure
articles.summary: The SCHD ETF is doing better than S&P 500's VOO and Nasdaq 100's QQQ this year despite having a limited exposure to the AI supercycle
articles._summary: The Schwab US Dividend Equity ETF (NYSE: SCHD ) is hovering near its all-time high and is beating the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 in terms of total returns this year, a sign that there is demand for value stocks. The fund has performed well despite having limited exposure to high-growth sectors such as artificial intelligence (AI). Consumer staples is its largest sector allocation, accounting for 20% of the portfolio. It is followed by healthcare, energy, and industrials, giving the fund a more defensive sector mix.
articles._zh_headline: 尽管人工智能曝光有限，但 SCHD ETF 今年仍击败了 VOO 和 QQQ
articles._zh_summary: 施瓦布美国股息股票 ETF（纽约证券交易所股票代码：SCHD）目前徘徊在历史高点附近，今年的总回报率超过了标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克 100 指数，这表明对价值股票的需求。尽管该基金对人工智能（AI）等高增长行业的投资有限，但仍表现良好。消费必需品是其最大的配置行业，占投资组合的 20%。其次是医疗保健、能源和工业，这使得该基金的行业组合更具防御性。
